title: International applicants
description: Prepare for an international degree application.
intro: Start with your applicant category, then prepare your application through Yuan Ze University’s official system.

steps.title: Confirm your pathway
steps.copy: Review the international applicant guidance. Ask the Global Affairs Office if your nationality or education history needs clarification.

steps.title: Prepare your documents
steps.copy: Use the current brochure and program entry to organize academic records, language evidence and supporting materials.

steps.title: Apply and follow up
steps.copy: Submit through the official portal, watch for document requests and follow the instructions for admission results.

link.label: Open the official application portal (opens a new tab)

readiness: I have reviewed the current guidance for my applicant category.
I know which program and intake I am applying for.
I have checked the portal’s required documents and dates.

title: Domestic applicants
intro: Choose the route that applies to you and use its current department information to plan each step.

steps.title: Choose your route
steps.copy: Check the current department list, schedule and requirements for your undergraduate admission route.

steps.title: Prepare your application
steps.copy: For individual applications, explore the published portfolio and interview guidance, then follow your entry-year notice.

steps.title: Complete each step
steps.copy: Follow the official instructions for payment, document upload, interviews and results that apply to your route.

link.label: Open the official admission system (opens a new tab)

readiness: I have confirmed my route and the current IBSC department entry.
I have checked the review materials and interview arrangements for my route.
I know where to confirm that each required step is complete.

title: Overseas compatriot applicants
description: Guidance for overseas compatriot, Hong Kong and Macau applicants.
intro: Review the guidance for your identity and education history before gathering your supporting evidence.

steps.title: Review your category
steps.copy: Read the current overseas compatriot, Hong Kong and Macau guidance. Contact the Global Affairs Office if your status needs clarification.

steps.title: Gather your evidence
steps.copy: Use the current brochure to prepare identity, residence and academic documents, including verification where required.

steps.title: Apply and follow up
steps.copy: Complete the official online application and check email and the portal for review questions and admission results.

link.label: Open the official application portal (opens a new tab)

readiness: I have reviewed the category that applies to my background.
I have checked the evidence and verification instructions in the current brochure.
I have checked the official application dates and program entry.
